description: This Java class 'PcbMoveTool' provides functionality to read PCB design data from a file, move its components by specified offsets, and save the modified data. It serves as a utility tool for manipulating PCB layout elements programmatically.

classes.name: PcbMoveTool
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to read, move, and write PCB layout data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method that parses command-line arguments and initiates the move operation.

methods.name: readAndMove
methods.description: Reads PCB data from a file, applies movement, and returns the modified node.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Performs the movement of all relevant PCB components by specified offsets.

methods.name: movePts
methods.description: Moves points within a polygon by specified offsets.

methods.name: moveStartEnd
methods.description: Moves start and end points of a segment.

methods.name: moveAt
methods.description: Moves the 'at' coordinate of a module.

methods.name: moveCoordinatesInFirstChildren
methods.description: Moves coordinate data in the first child node.

methods.name: moveCoordinates
methods.description: Helper method to move coordinates within a PcbNode.
